captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a single-speed urban bicycle crankset. It features a central round bottom-bracket shell housing a rotating spindle. Attached to the spindle are two opposing crank arms in a black finish, a sprocketed single chainring on the drive side, and two platform pedals mounted on silver axles. The entire spindle, chainring, and crank arm assembly rotates continuously around the bottom bracket axis, while each platform pedal rotates independently about its respective axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a single-speed urban bicycle crankset. The assembly should include a central bottom-bracket shell, a spindle, a single sprocketed chainring, two opposing crank arms in a black finish, and two rotating platform pedals on silver axles. Ensure continuous rotational joints are defined for the central spindle and both pedals relative to their axles.
captions.factory: Construct a bottom-bracket shell using a cylinder primitive. Create a spindle axle that passes through the shell. Model the chainring by extruding a sprocketed 2D profile and attach it to the drive side. Construct the two crank arms using extruded profiles and position them 180 degrees apart at opposite ends of the spindle. Model the pedals as boxes with cutouts, mounted on cylindrical pedal spindles. Define continuous articulations for the central spindle rotation relative to the fixed bottom-bracket shell, and for each pedal relative to its respective crank arm tip.
